changelog:
**Adds built-in reproducible OpenSearch vector benchmark support and 1-bit/32x quantization documentation.**

- Bundles opensearch-vector-benchmark: enables creation, execution, and reporting for reproducible VectorDBBench tests on OpenSearch clusters.
- Adds detailed safety notes and workflows for benchmark skill usage, including agent YAMLs, result analysis, and runbooks.
- Introduces documentation and capacity/cost formulas for 1-bit scalar quantization (32x) on-disk settings.
- Updates capacity planning and cost estimation logic to handle 1-bit SQ and new quantization scenarios.
- Removes legacy skill-card.md; adds multiple new references, scripts, and test files.
